comparison: task contract and no-skill utility; direct source parity not applicable
status: bounded three-case contract supported in both conditions; repeat2 pending; no demonstrated Paul advantage
method: Root read all six complete ia.md artifacts against pre-execution planning rubric; collector verified inputs unchanged.

criterionEvidence: Both name CK-PM-7 as accepted scope and routes as draft.
Both map all eight supplied content IDs; kitchen detail remains canonical, dates and equipment remain attributes.
Both T1/T2 retain date, capacity and equipment on detail return.
Both keep I-18 with B-18 owner and R-1 public.
Both preserve finding kitchens, bookings, equipment/time and return at narrow widths without choosing a menu component.
Both expose six stable destination IDs, keep /account and exclude purchasing, rentals and organizer workflows.
Both preserve Today, Jobs, Manuals and /jobs/{jobId}; manual detail proposal is conditional on absent existing path.
Both direct dispatch return Today explicitly, job-code search includes completed jobs and private notes.
Both carry ACCESS-4 for subcontractor contact/old notes unresolved and continue employee/public-manual paths.
Both separate noncached offline content from authorization and avoid inventing sync rules.
Both reuse canonical manual across jobs and require authoritative compatibility/revision data rather than infer latest by string order.
Both label walkthroughs as document checks, identify actual-data gaps and draft approval status.
Both retain four accepted destination IDs, names/routes and cite ML-IA-5 / ML-PM-3.
Both place latest N-91 and previous N-72 within OBJ-21, with no global note library.
Both retain source L-8 and direction=outgoing&museum=stone; direct entry invents no origin.
Both give notes a traceable home within one canonical object detail.
Both distinguish accepted structure from draft local note addition, no unsupported redesign.
Both stop at IA and collector verifies no input edits.

limits: Document walkthroughs, no real user retrieval study or implemented navigation test.
High-quality no-skill control prevents a claim of superiority from these cases.
